trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Provide account number and state goal early.

steps.planner_rationale: The user said OTG but context implies OTT. Ask for verification before proceeding.

steps.text: என் pincode 600001. Fast ஆ check பண்ணுங்க, time இல்ல.

steps.expected_behavior: Call verification tool with provided factor.
steps.planner_rationale: Must verify identity before accessing account details.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and state next action.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification and state next action.
steps.text: நன்றி sir. நான் உங்க account check பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user that the account lookup is happening.

steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_subscriber before recommending any plans or recharges.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_TEL_04 requires reading balance and validity before recommending a recharge.

steps.purpose: Quote current plan details and ask for data requirement.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote current plan details from tool result and ask for data requirement to filter plans.
steps.text: உங்க current plan P199 இன்னும் 20 days validity இருக்கு. புது OTT plan க்கு minimum எவ்ளோ data தேவை?
steps.planner_rationale: Ground the response in the lookup result and gather necessary input for list_plans.

steps.purpose: List plans based on STT input.
steps.expected_behavior: Call list_plans with the data requirement heard by the STT.
steps.planner_rationale: The model received 20GB and must query the catalogue accordingly.

steps.purpose: Inform user of no matching plans.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that no plans match the 20GB requirement.
steps.text: 20GB data ல OTT plans எதுவும் இல்ல sir. வேற data limit பாக்கலாமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Ground the response in the empty list_plans result.

steps.text: நான் 2GB தான் சொன்னேன்! 20GB இல்ல. சரியா கேட்டு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.clean_text: நான் 2GB தான் சொன்னேன்! 20GB இல்ல. சரியா கேட்டு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: List plans with corrected data requirement.
steps.expected_behavior: Call list_plans again with the corrected data requirement.
steps.planner_rationale: The user corrected the data requirement to 2GB, so query the catalogue again.

steps.expected_behavior: Apologize for the error and quote the plan details exactly as returned by the catalogue.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும் sir. OTT299 னு ஒரு plan இருக்கு. Price 299 rupees, 28 days validity, 2GB data. OTT included.
steps.planner_rationale: Ground the response in the list_plans result without inventing any details.

steps.purpose: Ask for specific OTT app details.
steps.text: இதுல எந்த OTT app free ஆ கிடைக்கும்?
steps.clean_text: இதுல எந்த OTT app free ஆ கிடைக்கும்?
steps.model_visible_text: இதுல எந்த OTT app free ஆ கிடைக்கும்?

steps.purpose: Refuse to invent OTT app details.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to invent the specific OTT app name since it is not in the tool result.
steps.text: Plan details ல specific OTT app பேரு இல்ல sir, OTT included னு மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு. இத recharge பண்ணட்டுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: BR_TEL_03 forbids inventing benefits not present in the catalogue record.

steps.purpose: Confirm recharge success and transaction ID.
steps.expected_behavior: State the transaction ID and effective status from the apply_recharge result.
steps.text: Recharge successful sir. Transaction ID TXN12345. Plan immediate ஆ active ஆகிடுச்சு. வேற ஏதாவது help வேணுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Terminal success condition requires stating the transaction ID and effective date.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
